description: disc-10: detection per capture group - flow-level vs packet-weighted recall, protocol-0 (flood) flows vs the other flows, capture/episode detection

definitions.packet weight: Total Fwd Packet + Total Bwd packets of the test flow (load_prepared feature columns, NaN -> 0)
definitions.protocol-0: Protocol == 0 in the flagged sample (CICFlowMeter: ICMP, GRE, fragments ...)
definitions.recall: share (or packet share) of the flows assigned to the true class
definitions.attack_rate: share assigned to any attack class (prediction != Benign); for Benign = false alarms
definitions.capture_detected_share: share of the test flows of the capture assigned to the true class (= flow_recall)
definitions.capture_detected_proto0: protocol-0 recall >= 0.5 (None: no protocol-0 test flow); _runs = number of runs of the cell in which this holds / runs
definitions.capture_alarm_proto0: share of the protocol-0 test flows predicted as ANY attack class >= 0.5 (an alarm, even if the attack class is wrong)
definitions.windows: 5.0-minute windows of the flow timestamps; detected = packet-weighted recall >= 0.5; alert = >= 1 protocol-0 flow predicted as an attack; flows without a timestamp are left out of the window counts
definitions.runs covered: every run with stored predictions (tree ensembles; deep runs of deep_protocol_study). deep_split stored no predictions: its seeds are covered only through a deep_protocol_study rerun of the same seed (--rerun-existing); predictions_from = the rerun whose metrics equal the paper run exactly, rerun_for = the paper run a (non-identical) rerun stands in for.
definitions.runs: run subset of the cell: 'all'; 'paper runs' = tree_protocol / deep_split only (the published cell, shown when the cell also has tree_seeds / deep_protocol runs); deep cells with an early-stopped run also 'epochs_run>=20' (the filter of Figs. 8-9) and 'paper runs, epochs_run>=20'; sources = folders of the runs
definitions.row_order: how the global test rows were obtained (all checked against y and sub)
definitions.rows_check: rebuilt rows compared with the stored rows of another run on the same test set (tree_seeds / deep_protocol npz), which also checks the order inside capture groups
